title: If the watchman stays silent…
paragraphs:
If the watchman stays silent…
who warns the city?
God gave watchmen a terrifying responsibility.
In Ezekiel 33:6, the Lord says that if the watchman sees danger coming but fails to sound the alarm, the people may perish—and their blood is required at the watchman’s hand.
This isn’t just about ancient city walls.
It’s about truth in a generation that prefers silence.

Today many watchmen see the danger:
• spiritual deception
• moral confusion
• watered-down truth
• a sleeping church
But too often the trumpet stays quiet.

The world doesn’t need louder opinions.
It needs faithful watchmen who refuse to stay silent.

The warning is not hatred.
The warning is love.
Because a watchman who truly cares will speak before the danger reaches the gates.

Are we protecting comfort…
or sounding the trumpet?
Do you think the modern church has too many silent watchmen?
“Being a watchman doesn’t mean attacking people—it means loving them enough to warn them. What do you think a watchman looks like today?”
